seoTitle: Responsive Image srcset and sizes Generator with Resized Files
metaDescription: Upload one image, pick widths and get an img tag with srcset, sizes, width and height plus resized WebP or JPEG files. Runs in your browser.
intro: Creates an img tag with srcset and sizes and the resized image files for the widths you choose.
why:
Serving one large image to every phone wastes data. A srcset lets the browser choose the smallest file that is sharp enough.

This tool resizes your image in a canvas to each width, never larger than the original, and writes the srcset, sizes, width and height attributes. The sizes value must match your layout, so the default is only a starting point. Nothing is uploaded.
howTo: List the widths and set the sizes attribute for your layout.
Pick WebP, JPEG or PNG and a quality.
Download the files and paste the markup.

faq.a: Widths larger than the original are dropped, because upscaling adds bytes without detail.
WebP is widely supported and smaller than JPEG. AVIF cannot be created in the browser by this site.
The width the image is drawn at for each breakpoint, in CSS pixels or vw units.
